text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and decision-making. Machine learning is a key part of AI. It allows computers to learn from data and improve without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it in voice assistants, search engines, online shopping recommendations, and navigation apps. AI is changing the way we live and work.
